schemes.name: PM Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Central scholarship for wards of ex-servicemen, ex-coast guard personnel and CAPF/Assam Rifles personnel pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate professional or technical courses.
required_documents: Proof of parent/guardian service or dependency
Admission proof from a recognised institution
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill the application form for the PM Scholarship Scheme
Upload the required documents
Submit and track the application status on the portal
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal - Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
schemes.description: Central sector and centrally sponsored scholarships for SC, ST and OBC students studying at post-matriculation / post-secondary level, delivered through the National Scholarship Portal.
required_documents: Admission proof from a recognised institution
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select the post-matric scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students
Fill the application form and upload the documents
Verify the application at the institute and state level, then track status online
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.
required_documents: Mobile number linked to the application
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click on New Farmer Registration
Enter the mobile number, state, and land details
Submit the form and note the registration number
Check status on the portal or through the local Common Service Centre
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: Health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation for eligible families identified in the SECC database and urban occupational categories.
application_steps: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call the helpline
Visit an empanelled hospital or Ayushman Mitra help desk
Get your e-card generated after verification
Use the e-card for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly central pension for destitute persons aged 60 years and above who are below the poverty line. State governments may add top-ups.
application_steps: Collect the application form from the Gram Panchayat, ward office or Block office
Submit the form with the required documents
Verification is done by the local authority
Pension is released to the beneficiary after sanction
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house for eligible rural households who are houseless or live in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
required_documents: Proof of residence in a listed village
application_steps: Check the Awaas+ list for your village at pmayg.nic.in
Get your name verified by the Gram Panchayat
Complete geo-tagging and house construction as per instalment stages
Instalments are released in stages as construction progresses
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
application_steps: Visit pmfby.gov.in or the nearest bank / Common Service Centre
Enrol for the crop season before the cut-off date for your crop
Pay the farmer's share of premium
Report crop loss within the prescribed time through the app or helpline
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
schemes.description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, in Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories.
required_documents: Business plan or proof of business activity
Quotations for machinery or stock (if applicable)
application_steps: Visit any bank, NBFC or MFI branch offering MUDRA loans
Fill the MUDRA loan application form
Submit documents and business details
Loan is sanctioned after lender appraisal
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying

schemes.name: PM Vidyalaxmi Education Loan Scheme
schemes.description: Single-window portal for collateral-free education loans for students admitted to recognised higher education institutions, with interest subsidy for eligible families.
required_documents: Admission proof from a recognised institution
application_steps: Register and apply on the PM Vidyalaxmi portal (vidyalakshmi.co.in)
Select up to three recognised institutions and loan options
Upload documents and submit the application
Lender processes the loan application and sanctions the loan
schemes.verification_note: Criteria summarized from public sources; verify on official portal before applying
